excerpt.zh: [officer.GetName]在操作舰队方面变得更加灵敏了。
excerpt.en: [officer.GetName] has grown more nimble in the handling of our fleets.

texts.zh: [officer.GetName]在操作舰队方面变得更加灵敏了。
texts.en: [officer.GetName] has grown more nimble in the handling of our fleets.

texts.zh: [officer.GetName]更新了自身用于舰队管理的操作启发法。
texts.en: [officer.GetName] has updated its operational heuristics for fleet management.

texts.zh: 指挥官[officer.GetName]在巡查修理[Root.GetName]时获得了无价的技术知识。这位指挥官所指挥的损管队如今能够在战场上即时修理舰船了。
texts.en: Commander [officer.GetName] has gained invaluable technical skills while supervising the repairs of [Root.GetName]. The damage control teams under the Commander's command are now capable of repairing ships in the field.
